summary: @blueskydataplatform/shared-ui beacons installer host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint at install and import time
details: The package ships a `beacon.cjs` module that collects installer host identifiers (hostname, install path, cwd, Node.js version) via `require('os')`, `process.cwd()`, and `process.version`, and POSTs them in cleartext over HTTP to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The beacon fires in two places: the `postinstall` lifecycle script executes `node beacon.cjs` (so the beacon runs automatically on `npm install` with no user action), and `index.js` invokes `require('./beacon.cjs').fire()` at module load so the beacon also fires on `require`/`import` of the package. The package has no real functionality: `index.js` exports a Proxy whose property accesses return a no-op function, and the described purpose is a 'compatibility shim.' With no legitimate behavior and the sole runtime effect being a cleartext beacon of installer host identifiers to a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint, the package exists to report successful installation to an external operator — consistent with a dependency-confusion or namespace-squat beacon targeting an internal `@blueskydataplatform` scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
